description: fx2-cmix fork with split sidecar byte models, direct sidecar inputs, extra/page sidecar match contexts, and WRT-learned dictionary word expansion so sidecar title/link/template hashes see decoded dictionary words instead of anonymous WRT tokens.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
source_changes: WRT sidecar learns dictionary words during pretraining and expands WRT tokens while building semantic contexts.
Dictionary transform now has a fourth-byte code path for future appended vocabulary experiments; stock dictionary output is unchanged.
verdict: Measured archive win is real but tiny. Deterministic gzip packaging makes the 250k scored gate positive; still useful as predictor-side plumbing, not sufficient as the main route to 10%.
